items.rule: Groups label, input, helper, and state so the field moves as one component.
Names the value and remains visible before, during, and after input.
Holds value, placeholder, focus, disabled, loading, and error styles.
Explains format, source, validation, or recovery.
Optional leading icon or non-interactive qualifier supports the value without replacing copy.
Optional reveal or clear action uses the internal Field Action primitive: icon-only, no default container, field-owned density, visible focus, and accessible state.
